purpose: Computes how long a token leg that settles at any hour waits for a cash leg that only moves while a payment rail is open. From a token leg instant and either a list of UTC open windows or a caller-declared rail calendar (weekday window rules, UTC offsets declared by date range, holidays), it returns the exposure in seconds, the principal-seconds product as an exact decimal string, the next window open and close, a weekend-crossing flag, and an optional carry cost at a stated funding rate (actual over 365, rounded half to even). The verdict is ATOMIC_POSSIBLE inside an open window, WINDOWED when a later window opens within the horizon, and NO_WINDOW_IN_HORIZON otherwise. The node hardcodes no rail calendar and reads no clock: every hour, offset and holiday is a caller-asserted input, and the calendar must declare the dates it covers. Integers and strict UTC time strings only; floats, nulls, numeric principals, impossible dates and undeclared offsets refuse by named code. It computes no balance-sheet saving and names no unannounced product.
